name: When the Moon Blooms
source:
Was buying a one-way ticket on the next spaceflight to the moon after receiving an old-fashioned letter a mistake? Maybe.

Was betting your grandparent's farm and your childhood sanctuary with your capitalist cousin also a mistake? Also maybe.

But you did it. And now you're here at Crescent Vale, with just a year to prepare for the community's long-forgotten Lunar Bloom festival. 

Crescent Vale was once a bustling settlement, the first in its galaxy, but centuries of expansion have left it behind. Nonetheless, there is magic here; In the land, and practiced by the few but colourful residents of the community. It's the perfect place to start a new chapter of your grandparent's legacy, but more importantly, a new beginning for you.

[From [url=https://craboozled.itch.io/when-the-moon-blooms]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
在收到一封老式信件后购买下一次飞往月球的单程票是一个错误吗？或许。

把你祖父母的农场和你童年的庇护所与你的资本主义表弟打赌也是一个错误吗？也或许。

但你做到了。现在你来到了新月谷，只有一年的时间来为社区里被遗忘已久的农历花节做准备。

新月谷曾经是一个熙熙攘攘的定居点，是银河系中的第一个定居点，但几个世纪的扩张已经将其抛在了后面。尽管如此，这里还是有魔力的。在这片土地上，由社区中少数但丰富多彩的居民实践。这是开启祖父母遗产新篇章的完美场所，但更重要的是，这对你来说是一个新的开始。

[来自[url=https://craboozled.itch.io/when-the-moon-blooms]itch.io[/url]]
